description: A peer that answers our ARQ data twice with WARNING reason 1 holds no connection with us: the link is half open, so it is broken locally and the C_PDU rejected, and the next U_PDU makes a new link.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. At 61000 the peer's first DATA C_PDU arrives: a DATA-ONLY (FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, both window flags, EOT 10) with 'ping' for SAP 9, which no client has bound, so the SIS discards it (A-0235); it is the first DATA C_PDU by ARQ, so cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403), and it owes an acknowledgement. At 61500 conn 1 sends an ARQ U_PDU 'pong' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 (TTL 0); the soft link exists (A-0194), so it goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (10 bytes: the S_PDU with TTD and 'pong') and dts.ttd runs to its TTD. At 78000 it goes in a DATA-ACK (FSN 0, RX LWE 1, DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked, both window flags, C-1128), 32 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20, with an ACK-ONLY copy in the fill (C-1154); dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts at 88350 (C-1120). Retransmissions are DATA-ONLY (29 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20) with a PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes, EOT 10) in the spare bytes (C-1154). At 96000 the peer, which has lost the link (say its own first-data wait or a reset of its node ended it), answers with a WARNING (type 15, EOT 10) naming type 11, reason 1: a connection-related D_PDU while it is unconnected (C-0578, C-0734). One alone is not enough (B-0426). At 148350 dts.ack_wait expires and FSN 0 is retransmitted: the burst heard was addressed to us alone, so LBT rule 1 gives no LBT wait (K-0067), contention 45000 ms, out at 193350, dts.ack_wait again at 203700. At 211000 a second WARNING reason 1, naming type 9, with no ARQ C_PDU from the peer between: the link is half open (B-0426). The first-data wait is over, so the peer is not still calling us (B-0214, B-0215). The CAS breaks the link locally, as for D_CONNECTION_LOST (B-0324): link_state unlinked, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED to the DTS, which stops dts.ack_wait and rejects the unconfirmed C_PDU (C-0866), so dts.ttd is cancelled, and C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS, which ends the soft link (A-0199). At 230000 conn 1 sends 'more': with no soft link the SIS holds it and asks for a new physical link (A-0193): link_state calling, and the PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) goes after LBT rule 1 and 36000 ms of contention, at 266000, our C_PDU ID 1; cas.link_request starts at 271550. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. WARNING 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
